Allowed origins (CORS allowlist in `worker/src/index.ts`, inside the `origin` callback passed to `cors(...)`, ~lines 20–30):
- `http://localhost:4200` (exact match)
- any subdomain of `.pages.dev`
- any subdomain of `.workers.dev`

Any other origin returns `null` and is rejected.

To add a new custom domain: edit that same `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts`, adding another `origin === '...'` or `origin.endsWith('...')` check inside the `if (...)` condition (per `docs/code/worker/src/index.md` and `DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md §4`). Note Hono's `cors()` array form only does exact-string matches, so wildcard subdomains must stay in this function form.
